paper.comment: Body copy, form fields, and most UI text. Used at weights 400-800 depending on emphasis.

head.comment: Display headings, always set at weight 900. Sized fluidly with clamp() for large hero/section titles.

mono.comment: Section labels, meta text, tags, and tabular data. Almost always uppercase and letter-spaced in context.

xs.comment: Smallest UI text (card CTA links). Steps consumed directly as $scale-paper-xs etc. in app/styles/*.scss

sm.comment: Small UI text (buttons, tags, secondary labels)

base.comment: Body copy, the most common paper size

xs.comment: Small bold labels (brand lockup, card titles)

xl.comment: Case-study hero title, fluid clamp() max

2xl.comment: Contact hero title, fluid clamp() max

3xl.comment: Masthead hero title, fluid clamp() max — the largest text on the site. xl/2xl/3xl stay distinct steps (not collapsed) because they carry real page-type hierarchy: home > contact > case study
